text: The Patriots roster continues to shuffle with the release of LB Jose Ramirez and practice squad moves involving CB Al'Zillion Hamilton and OL Da'Metrius Weatherspoon, while the organization prepares for a significant milestone as they'll honor Adam Vinatieri's Pro Football Hall of Fame induction during halftime against the Raiders on October 11. On the field, New England bounced back impressively from an early-season stumble by defeating the Bills 29-26 in Week 4, with QB Drake Maye delivering a clutch performance that snapped his early slide and helped the defending AFC champions improve to 2-2 after staring down a potential 1-3 disaster alongside the Rams and Cowboys. The victory over Josh Allen's Bills earned considerable praise for the offensive execution, with film breakdowns highlighting how the unit broke out during the narrow win at Highmark Stadium—though head coach Mike Vrabel and the defensive unit know the coming week brings a significant test against Las Vegas's tight end duo of Brock Bowers and Michael Mayer, teams the Patriots successfully contained in Week 4 with their shutdown of Dalton Kincaid.
